thread:
Maria C.: FYI — Novara sent back their vendor risk form and flagged three 'must-resolve' items blocking their Dedicated onboarding. PDF attached to the ticket. TL;DR: encryption at rest/KMS questions, SOC2 scope verification, and a records-retention clause difference. Need quick triage. :eyes:

Evan S.: Thanks. Can you paste the exact wording on the KMS item? sometimes it's just ambiguous about BYOK vs our KMS.

Maria C.: Sure — quote from their form: "Customer requires tenant-dedicated key control (BYOK/HSM) for PHI workloads or explicit documentation that keys are destroyed after retention period." They marked it as a hard blocker for prod cert.

Priya R.: Got it. For Dedicated we support customer-managed keys in our Private deployment but not in Hosted. We need to confirm scope (they asked Dedicated right?). Also need to know whether they consider embeddings PHI — that'll change controls.

Maria C.: Novara selected Dedicated in the contract and listed a PHI use case. So assume PHI unless they retract.

Jenna L.: On SOC2: their security team is asking for evidence that the Redwood scope covers data-at-rest controls and key management. We should share the SOC2 sections we can disclose and propose a redaction plan. I'll draft a short cover letter.

Dan O.: Quick ops checklist proposal: 1) Confirm Dedicated infra + BYOK feasibility 2) Ask Novara to confirm PHI classification in writing 3) Produce redacted SOC2 excerpt + KMS diagram 4) Agree SLA for key rotation/secure key destruction 5) Meeting with Novara security.

onboarding-bot: Document uploaded to ticket #CS-19821 — novara_riskform_v1.pdf (uploaded by Maria C.)

Evan S.: For BYOK details we need infra owner — @Priya R. does infra-runbook for Private include HSM integration steps? If so, can we provide an ETA?

Priya R.: We have a runbook but the current flow is tested for our Private appliance, not every cloud partner. For Dedicated we can spin a HSM-backed key namespace, but it needs a short engineering chore: 1 dev-day to wire the key rotation hooks + 1 SRE day to smoke test. Realistic ETA: 7 business days if prioritized.

Maria C.: I'll tell Novara that BYOK is possible for Dedicated but needs a short delivery window. Can we scope which artifacts they want from SOC2 now so Jenna can prepare them?

Jenna L.: Ask them specifically for: 
- Which SOC2 controls they care about (e.g., CC6, CC7 for encryption)
- Whether they need evidence (reports) or just control descriptions + artifact list
I'll prepare a redacted PDF and a one-page control summary once they confirm.

Evan S.: Also flagging a product nuance: embeddings retention default is 30 days for Dedicated unless they opt-out. Novara's form asks for retention <=7 days. We need to confirm whether we can shorten retention for their tenant. Ops, @Dan O. any constraints?

Dan O.: We can configure retention per-tenant in Dedicated but it requires a config rollout and a DB-migration window. Estimate 3 business days to schedule + 1 day to perform. No infra change required, just ops time.

Maria C.: Great. I'll propose a single 30-min sync with Novara security + product + legal to align on three items (BYOK, retention, SOC2 artifacts). Proposed times: Tue 10am or Wed 4pm PT. Which works for folks here?

Priya R.: Wed 4pm PT works for infra.

Evan S.: Tue 10am PT OK for me. If Wed is better for infra we'll go with Wed.

Jenna L.: Wed 4pm PT I can make.

Dan O.: Wed 4pm PT good.

Maria C.: Ok Wed 4pm PT scheduled then. I'll send calendar invite and a short agenda. Action items for now:
- Maria: send Novara the SOC2 scope question and ASK for PHI confirmation (today)
- Priya: prepare HSM/BYOK feasibility note + ETA (7 business days)
- Dan: prepare retention-change ops plan + rough schedule (3 business days)
- Jenna: draft redacted SOC2 cover note template to be populated after they respond

Maria C.: Novara — can you confirm whether the data sent to our models contains PHI (yes/no) and which environments you require BYOK for (staging/prod)? Also please indicate whether a 7-day retention would satisfy your regulatory requirement or if you need <=1 day.

onboarding-bot: Reminder set for follow-up in 48 hours on ticket #CS-19821

Novara Security (via email forwarded by Maria): thanks — we'll confirm PHI status and preferred retention by EOD tomorrow.

Evan S.: Sounds good. Once we get their responses we'll decide whether the SOC2 excerpt + runbook is enough or if we need an SOC2 bridge call. :thumbsup:

Maria C.: Thanks team — I'll keep this thread updated with Novara's replies and attach any artifacts. If anything blocks your action items ping here. :sparkles:
